description: This file defines the RecognizeCommands class in the org.tensorflow.demo package, which processes audio recognition results over time to produce smoothed recognition outputs and detect commands.

classes.name: RecognizeCommands
classes.description: Handles processing and smoothing of recognition results from an audio recognition model.

classes.name: RecognizeCommands.RecognitionResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of recognition processing, including detected command, score, and whether it's a new command.

methods.name: RecognizeCommands
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the recognizer with labels and various timing/detection parameters.

methods.name: processLatestResults
methods.description: Processes new recognition scores at a given timestamp, updates internal state, and determines if a new command has been recognized.
